name: artisan-dev
description: Runs `php artisan dev` for a Laravel project and manages it from a pane: per-process logs, restart and stop controls, port override, site and tunnel links.

projectDir.title: Project folder
projectDir.description: Absolute path of the Laravel app whose `php artisan dev` this manages. Empty uses the session's folder; when the session starts inside a worktree, the same folder in the main checkout.

tunnelHosts.title: Extra tunnel hosts
tunnelHosts.description: Comma-separated domains whose URLs count as a public tunnel, e.g. my-tunnel.example.com. Built in: Cloudflare, ngrok, Expose/Herd share, localtunnel, localhost.run, Serveo, Pinggy, Tailscale funnel, Dev Tunnels.
